record.reason: The method extracts tips from previous agent trajectories and retrieves them into future prompts to reduce repeated ineffective behavior. It improves task outcomes, but primary evidence does not establish reduced model calls, prompt tokens, latency, or inference cost.
record.title: Trajectory-Informed Memory Generation for Self-Improving Agent Systems
